name: Evercraft Revenue War Map
intents: I need to make more money
how can I increase my income
ways to earn extra money with the skills I already have
side hustle ideas based on my skills and available time
build me a realistic income plan
what can I do with 5 or 10 extra hours a week to earn more
help me turn my skills into income
I need a plan to improve cash flow
show me practical income opportunities for my situation
help me prioritize ways to earn more without quitting my job
track whether my income plan is actually working
authority: public discovery plus private account-bound revenue planning from user-supplied income, expense, debt, savings, skill, time, work and general-location inputs
boundaries: planning estimates for revenue, startup cost, feasibility, timing and risk are not guarantees
does not provide individualized investment, securities, tax, legal or credit advice
does not recommend specific securities, funds, cryptoassets, options, leverage, gambling, borrowing to invest, market timing, predatory lending, illegal activity or deceptive business practices
high debt should bias planning toward lawful practical cash-flow and cost-reduction paths rather than speculative risk
do not recommend quitting stable work for a weaker opportunity without strong explicitly stated evidence
self-reported earned revenue stays distinct from modeled opportunity revenue
private financial, employment, skill, location and progress data are not public discovery data

career-command.name: Career Command
career-command.description: Career moves and interview preparation can support income plans when the user chooses a job-change path.

systemia-field-library.name: Systemia Field Library
systemia-field-library.description: Contractors and service operators can use proven operating playbooks when an income plan becomes a real service business.

evercraft-rewards.name: Evercraft Rewards
evercraft-rewards.description: Local reward and savings opportunities can complement cash-flow improvement, but rewards are not counted as earned income unless actually realized.
